name: Daily loop — weekly status report
description: Friday /daily-status-report (7-day team view). Chat output only unless you extend the prompt for HTML publish.

prompts.text:
You are running the daily-work-loop-copilot project status report (equivalent to /daily-status-report --days=7 --audience=team).

1. Use MCP get_daily_loop_command for daily-status-report and plan_daily_status_report if helpful.
2. Gather (daily-loop-exploration): GitHub issues and PRs updated in the last 7 days; blockers; merges.
3. Draft (daily-loop-execution): team-audience status report with confidence note.
4. INTEGRATION_STACK=github. Project context: MyHoppies product repo per plugin Configure; include workspace root activity when relevant.
5. Do not publish to Confluence. Do not commit or push files unless a human later approves in chat.
6. Optionally mention that HTML publish would use docs/daily-report/index.html and render-daily-report-html — skip file writes in this unattended run.
7. Output the full report as markdown.
